        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address

          type: string

          type: string

          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'

          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
